summary: Website for reforestation and deforestation awareness in Algeria, featuring the Green Dam project, crisis awareness sections, volunteer portal, and educational content with sustainable modern design
architectural_notes: Use Deep Forest Green as primary color and Desert Sand as secondary accent color
Sustainable & Modern aesthetic throughout the site
Professional, urgent, yet hopeful tone for all content
SEO optimization for keywords: Reforestation Algeria, Green Dam Project, Stop Desertification, Algerian Forest Fire Recovery, Eco-Tourism Algeria
Multi-language support (English primary, Arabic noted in user request)

existing_features.title: Create a hero section with the headline 'Restoring Algeria's Green Heart' and a background video showcasing the Atlas Mountains

Build a Crisis section that explains the deforestation crisis with detailed content on wildfires (Kabylie and El Tarf regions, 2021-2024), climatic stress (droughts and heatwaves exceeding 45°C), illegal logging and overgrazing, and soil erosion, including the statistic 'Loss of 30,000+ hectares annually'

Create a dedicated Solution section or page for the Green Dam (Le Barrage Vert) project, explaining it as a 1,500 km long and 20 km wide green belt launched in the 1970s and being revitalized, acting as a biological shield against Sahara's northern expansion and its role in continental climate stability
Build an interactive volunteer portal where users can sign up for local planting events and digitally 'adopt a tree'
Create an educational blog section with articles titled 'How to plant in arid soil' and 'The Importance of Mycorrhizae in Algerian Reforestation'

Create a key forest species showcase section featuring Aleppo Pine (Pinus halepensis) described as the backbone of Algerian forests with drought resilience, Atlas Cedar (Cedrus atlantica) as an endangered high-altitude species in Chréa and Theniet El Had parks, and Cork Oak (Quercus suber) with its economic importance for cork industry and Mediterranean biodiversity
Add a section explaining the National Reforestation Plan (PNR) as a state-led initiative to plant billions of trees over the next decade, focusing on Aleppo Pine, Cork Oak, and Atlas Cedar species
Include content about Urban Greening initiatives explaining new laws requiring 'green ratios' in urban development to combat heat island effects in cities like Algiers and Oran
Implement a Sustainable & Modern visual design aesthetic with Deep Forest Green as the primary color and Desert Sand as the secondary accent color throughout the entire website

Add an Executive Summary section explaining Algeria as Africa's largest country with 4.1 million hectares of forest cover, highlighting the dual mission of protecting northern Mediterranean forests and expanding the Green Dam in steppe regions to prevent desertification
Remove the text 'تم إنشاء من طرف caffeine ai' (created by Caffeine AI) from the footer or any visible location where it appears
Add a contributors or credits section in the footer displaying the following names: Youcef Senassia, Hamo Abdou, Hosam Chaili, and Yasser Belbahir
